title: JV Ejercito backs stronger DOJ, NBI cybercrime efforts amid online scams

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito has pledged full support for efforts by the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to combat cybercrime, cyber fraud and other online scams, including securing adequate funding to strengthen their capabilities. Ejercito, chair of the Senate Committee on Finance and the Committee on Justice, said the cybercrime units of the DOJ and NBI must be sufficiently funded to address the growing threat of online fraud and other cyber-related offenses. “We need to strengthen our cybercrime units because this is a clear and present danger.
